top5.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra, GPT-6.2 Sol and ChatGPT for Sales
top5.description: OpenAI launched GPT-6.2 Astra, its new flagship model, along with GPT-6.2 Sol, a more efficient version. The lab also launched ChatGPT for Sales, with ready-to-use sales workflows, while early reviews of the models are often negative.
top5.why: OpenAI’s launch of GPT-6.2 models and ChatGPT for Sales could reshape enterprise AI adoption and intensify competition in the fast-growing AI platform market.

top5.title: Nvidia maintains strategy and halts licensed Hopper shipments to China
top5.description: Nvidia says its roadmap remains unchanged and that it continues to support an open AI ecosystem. Colette Kress nevertheless said the company was no longer shipping licensed Hopper data-center products to China.
top5.why: Nvidia’s decision to halt licensed Hopper shipments to China highlights the continuing impact of export controls on semiconductor revenues, supply chains and China’s AI capabilities.

top5.title: Google’s AI answers reduce clicks to websites by 40%
top5.description: A randomized experiment indicates that Google’s AI Overviews reduce clicks to external websites by about 40%. They now appear in 61% of tracked searches in the United States.
top5.why: Google AI Overviews reducing external website clicks by about 40% could materially disrupt publishers, search-driven customer acquisition and the economics of the open web.

top5.title: Isomorphic Labs raises $5 billion to accelerate drug discovery
top5.description: Isomorphic Labs, Demis Hassabis’s AI drug-discovery company, has raised $5 billion in a Series C round. The company plans to develop its drug-design engine and its own therapeutic pipeline, though this does not guarantee a shortcut to approved treatments.
top5.why: Isomorphic Labs’ $5 billion financing signals exceptional investor confidence in AI-driven drug discovery while accelerating competition between platform development and proprietary therapeutics.

top5.title: Waymo suspends highway rides in the United States
top5.description: California has banned Waymo robotaxis from its highways after incursions into construction zones and an attempt to pass a police car. Waymo has suspended highway rides across all its US markets.
top5.why: Waymo’s suspension of highway rides nationwide after construction-zone incidents is a significant operational and regulatory setback for autonomous-vehicle commercialization.
